page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, delivering 16 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which includes 47,244 GB of local HDD storage. This high-capacity storage is bundled directly with the instance. For external connectivity and data transfer, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

Given the massive local HDD storage capacity combined with a balanced CPU and memory profile, this instance offers high resource density for storage-heavy workloads. It is qualitatively cost-effective for applications requiring large-capacity local data retention without the premium cost of solid-state storage. Suitable workloads include large-scale data warehousing, log processing, big data analytics, and cold or warm storage databases.
